title: Add CI lint for Data/**/*.json well-formedness (strict JSON, no raw control characters)
description:
Seven task records under Data/Tasks contained raw (unescaped) newlines inside JSON strings, which fail strict JSON parsing. TaskDomainService surfaces them as HasLoadError=true and refuses edits ('malformed JSON and cannot be edited until fixed'), so the records were dead weight in the live wiki until repaired (fixed in this commit: tsk-0218, 0220, 0221, 0222, 0224, 0251, 0252).

### Approach
- Add a small script (Scripts/validate_data_json.py or a dotnet test) that strict-parses every Data/**/*.json and fails on parse errors, raw control characters in strings, or duplicate task keys
- Wire it into the build-and-test CI job (fast, no app boot)
- Optionally extend to Data/Memories records (complements TSK-0003's schema validation)

### Acceptance criteria
- CI fails when a malformed JSON record is committed
- Validator runs in under a few seconds and reports the offending file and position
